t: You're looking at the bronze statue of Charlie Chaplin in Leicester Square, made in 1979 by the sculptor John Doubleday. It shows Chaplin in his best-known role, the Tramp. Chaplin was an English comic actor and filmmaker who rose to fame in the silent film era, and the Tramp made him a worldwide icon. His career spanned more than seventy-five years. Doubleday is a British sculptor whose statues include Nelson Mandela, Sherlock Holmes, Laurel and Hardy and The Beatles.
